video.title: Platform Engineering explained | Devops vs platform engineers 🧑‍💻

transcript.text: most of you are confused between devops
engineers and platform Engineers so in
30 seconds I will explain you what is
platform engineering imagine you are
working as a developer in a startup and
you want to make a simple change you
would either do it manually or wait for
the devops engineers to automate it for
you this causes delays in deployment and
also dependency on the devops engineer
and this is where platform engineerings
come into play a platform engineer is
responsible to create idps or internal
developer platforms which is a single
interface that allow Developers to
automate all of this so when a developer
pushes the code in this ID piece it runs
the pipeline which automatically test
and builds the code also creates
infrastructures and deploy the changes
so platform engineering is the next big
thing and if you are a devops engineer
make sure to check it out subscribe
